subject: Next steps: stakeholder map & ambassador enablement
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@quantivehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: stakeholder map & ambassador enablement

Hi Maya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and the concrete next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary use case: extractive summarization + compliance inspection on claims ingestion (peak 2k reqs/min).
- Success criteria: 95% reduction in triage time for review tasks + <200ms median latency on 512-token responses.
- Key stakeholders: you (product champion), Liam (security), Carlos (procurement), and an economic owner in finance (TBD).

Immediate asks / next steps
1) I attached a first-pass stakeholder map and a mutual action plan (Quantive-MAP-v1.xlsx). Please review and flag missing names/roles.
2) Can you introduce Carlos & Liam on email so we can schedule a short procurement + security scoping slot?
3) We will prep a 1-page ROI snapshot and a SOW template for your procurement loop by EOD Monday.

Internal notes (Ben / Priyom)
- Ben: capture expected peak QPS and any on-prem constraints Maya mentioned (data residency).
- Priyom: sketch a pilot SLO (30-day pilot, 50k tokens/day, standard rollback).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick follow-up with procurement/security if that helps.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Quantive-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: stakeholders + timeline)
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@quantivehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantivehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder map & ambassador enablement

Thanks Neha — great summary. I ran this by the team this morning and quick updates: 
- Liam (cc'd) will own security review. He asked for our data flow diagram and any SOC2/SLA notes you have available.
- I'll loop in Carlos (procurement) after I confirm he can join a 30-minute alignment next week.
- Economic owner is Maria Patel (VP Finance) — I'll add her to the stakeholder map.

Can you send the SOW template and the ROI one-pager you mentioned? That will help Carlos move things through procurement. Meeting cadence: 30 minutes for security + procurement on Mon/Tue next week would work.

— Maya
Product Lead, Quantive Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Next steps: stakeholder map & ambassador enablement (internal)

Quick internal:
- Technical constraints: Maya mentioned retention rules for claims data — likely needs regional isolation (US-East). We'll propose a VPC-private deployment for the pilot. Priyom, can you draft the pilot SLO with these parameters?
- ROI assumptions: use 30% time saved for claims reviewers, average loaded salary $85k — I will assemble a 12-month TCO delta for the one-pager.
- Security pack: include SOC2 summary, data residency bullet, and our standard redaction guidance.

I can own the technical appendix for the SOW. Neha, if you want, I can join the procurement call and walk technical controls.

Ben
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@quantivehealth.com>, Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@quantivehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder map & ambassador enablement

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Maya — loop looks good. We've attached a few items to move procurement/security forward: 

Attachments included (stubs):
- Quantive-MAP-v1.xlsx — updated with Maria Patel as economic owner and tentative dates.
- SOW-template.pdf — standard pilot terms (30 days), success criteria, termination, and pricing placeholders.
- Redwood-one-pager.pdf — concise ROI assumptions + a sample cost model.

Proposed slots for procurement + security (30 min):
- Tue Oct 6, 10:00-10:30 PT
- Tue Oct 6, 15:00-15:30 PT

Ben will cover technical controls and Priyom will run through the pilot SLO. I'll present the commercial snapshot. If those times don't work, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Action items for Maya / Quantive team
- Confirm a slot and introduce Maria + Carlos to this thread if possible.
- Share any existing procurement forms (vendor questionnaire / PO template) so we can pre-fill.

Forwarding the SOW and MAP here for convenience.

Best,
Neha

Attachment notes: SOW-template.pdf (pdf, 6 pages), Redwood-one-pager.pdf (pdf, 1 page), Quantive-MAP-v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@quantivehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@quantivehealth.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@quantivehealth.com>, Maria Patel <maria.patel@quantivehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder map & ambassador enablement

Thanks Neha — that works. Carlos and Maria are now on the thread. Carlos, can you confirm whether 10:00 PT on Tue works for procurement? If not, 15:00 PT is our fallback.

A couple of quick asks from the procurement side:
- Pilot terms: Carlos wants an itemized cost table for the pilot and a statement of work with milestone-based invoicing.
- Security: Liam will send a short questionnaire; Neha/Ben, please watch for that and reply with the SOC2 summary and data flow diagram.

We aim to have procurement decision -> legal review within 10 business days if the pilot goes well. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Maya
Product Lead, Quantive Health
